lessons.title: Contexto, memória e documentos longos
lessons.summary: O que o modelo consegue ver, e por quanto tempo.

cards.title: A janela de contexto
cards.text: Tudo o que o modelo considera de uma vez (prompt de sistema, conversa, documentos, resultados de ferramentas) precisa caber na janela de contexto, medida em tokens. As janelas modernas vão de dezenas de milhares a mais de um milhão de tokens.

deep.x: The context window is the total number of tokens the model can process in one request: input plus output. It's the model's working memory for that request.
Sizes today
Input vs output limits
Models also have a maximum output length, often much smaller than the context window. Long reports may need to be generated in sections.
What counts
Everything counts: system prompt, earlier messages, attached files, tool results and the answer itself. Long chats fill the window quickly.
An image attached to a chat may consume around a thousand tokens or more, depending on resolution and the model.

cards.title: Maior nem sempre é melhor
cards.text: Contextos muito longos custam mais, demoram mais, e os modelos podem deixar passar detalhes enterrados no meio. Recuperar só as partes relevantes costuma dar respostas melhores e mais baratas.

deep.x: Long context is convenient but has costs. Price, latency and sometimes accuracy suffer as context grows.
Cost scaling
Accuracy effects
Benchmarks like "needle in a haystack" show modern models can find a single planted fact in long contexts, but harder tasks, reasoning over many scattered facts, degrade with length.
When long context shines

items: Analysing one long contract end to end

deep.x: Use long context for genuinely holistic tasks; use retrieval for lookups.

cards.title: Perdido no meio
cards.text: Estudos mostraram que os modelos lembram melhor as informações do início e do fim de contextos longos do que as do meio. Coloque as instruções-chave e a pergunta perto do fim, depois dos documentos longos.

deep.x: A 2023 Stanford study, "Lost in the Middle", found models used information at the beginning and end of long inputs much better than information in the middle: a U-shaped curve.

v.unit: accuracy by position of key information, % (illustrative)

deep.x: Practical tips

items: Put instructions and the question at the end
Repeat key constraints near the end
Use headings and labels in long inputs

deep.x: Newer models
Training on long-context tasks has reduced, but not eliminated, the effect in newer models. Test with your own documents.
Order matters in RAG too
When inserting retrieved passages, put the most relevant ones where the model attends best, often at the start and end.
Humans show a similar serial-position effect: we remember the first and last items in a list best.

cards.title: Memória da conversa
cards.text: Os apps de chat reenviam as mensagens anteriores ao modelo a cada turno. Quando uma conversa fica muito longa, as partes antigas são resumidas ou descartadas, então detalhes do início podem ser esquecidos.

deep.x: Language models are stateless: they don't remember previous requests. Chat apps simulate memory by resending the conversation history with each new message.
Managing long chats
Symptoms of overflow
The model forgets early instructions, contradicts earlier decisions or loses details from documents attached at the start.
Tip
For long projects, keep a running summary of key decisions and paste it into new chats, or use project features that store reference documents.
If an assistant "forgets" something you said, it may simply have scrolled out of its context.

cards.title: Memória de longo prazo
cards.text: Alguns assistentes guardam fatos entre conversas, como suas preferências ou projetos, e os recuperam depois. Você deve poder ver e apagar o que fica memorizado.

deep.x: Memory features let assistants persist information across conversations, like your role, preferences or ongoing projects, and bring it back when relevant.
Types

items.b: files agents write for later steps

deep.x: Control and privacy
Benefits and risks
Agent systems often keep "scratchpad" notes in files to remember progress across long tasks that exceed one context window.

cards.title: Cache de prompts

viz.unit: custo relativo de um prompt longo

cards.text: Se muitos pedidos compartilham o mesmo prefixo longo (instruções, um documento grande), os provedores podem guardá-lo em cache, reduzindo o custo e a latência das chamadas repetidas.

deep.x: Prompt caching stores the processed state of a repeated prompt prefix, such as long system instructions or a large document. Subsequent requests reusing that prefix skip recomputation.

v.unit: relative cost of cached input tokens (typical)

deep.x: How to benefit

items: Put stable content first: instructions, documents
Put variable content last: the user's question
Reuse the same prefix across many requests

deep.x: Savings
Providers often discount cached tokens by around 90%, and latency drops noticeably for long prompts.

steps: Request 2: reuse cache, process only new part

deep.x: Use cases

x: Q&A over the same long document

deep.x: Structure prompts with the unchanging parts first to unlock caching.

cards.title: Resumir e map-reduce
cards.text: Para documentos longos demais para uma única chamada, resuma as seções separadamente e depois junte os resumos: um padrão "map-reduce".

deep.x: When content exceeds the context window, or a single pass gives shallow results, split the work: process pieces independently (map), then combine the outputs (reduce).
Variations

items.b: iterate through parts, updating a running summary
pull facts from each part, then analyse together

deep.x: Pitfalls

x: Consistent formats needed for clean merging

deep.x: Example
Summarising 200 supplier contracts: extract key terms from each (map), then aggregate into a comparison table and risk summary (reduce).
Map steps can run in parallel, so processing hundreds of documents takes minutes rather than hours.

cards.title: Engenharia de contexto
cards.text: Criar bons apps de IA é, em grande parte, decidir o que entra no contexto: quais instruções, quais trechos recuperados, quais resultados de ferramentas, em que ordem e formato.

deep.x: Context engineering is the discipline of deciding exactly what information the model sees, in what form and order. It has largely replaced "prompt engineering" as the central skill in building AI applications.
Principles
For agents
Agents accumulate tool outputs and history over many steps. Techniques like summarising old steps, pruning irrelevant results and writing notes to files keep context focused.
Failure modes
Most "model failures" in applications are really context failures: the model didn't see what it needed.

cards.title: Orçamento de tokens

items.w: colar o manual inteiro de 200 páginas toda vez
items.r: recuperar as 3 seções relevantes

cards.text: Cada token de entrada custa dinheiro e tempo. Corte o texto padrão desnecessário, elimine trechos recuperados duplicados e mantenha as instruções concisas sem perder clareza.

deep.x: Tokens cost money and time. Efficient context design reduces costs without hurting quality.
Savings levers

items: Use smaller models for simple steps

deep.x: Output tokens
Output tokens often cost several times more than input tokens; asking for concise answers or structured outputs saves money.
Balance
Don't over-trim: cutting essential context to save tokens can cost more in errors and rework. Measure quality alongside cost.
Optimise tokens like any other cloud resource: measure, then trim what doesn't add value.

cards.title: Privacidade no contexto
cards.text: Tudo o que você coloca no contexto é enviado ao provedor do modelo. Confira as regras da sua organização sobre dados pessoais e confidenciais e use ferramentas corporativas aprovadas.

deep.x: Anything placed in a model's context is processed by the model provider's systems. Data protection rules and company policies apply.
Enterprise safeguards
Shadow AI
Employees pasting sensitive data into personal accounts of consumer AI tools is a major risk. Providing approved, easy-to-use tools reduces it.
Minimise
Only include data needed for the task; mask or pseudonymise personal identifiers where possible.
Surveys in 2024–25 found a large share of employees using AI tools at work that their employers hadn't approved.

quiz.q: Onde colocar a pergunta principal em um prompt longo?
options: Perto do fim, depois dos documentos longos
quiz.explain: Os modelos prestam bastante atenção ao final.

quiz.q: O que o cache de prompts economiza?
options: Custo e latência de prefixos longos repetidos
quiz.explain: Prefixos reutilizados ficam em cache.

quiz.q: Como resumir um documento longo demais para a janela de contexto?
options: Resumir as seções e depois juntar os resumos
quiz.explain: Resumo map-reduce.

lessons.title: O panorama dos modelos
lessons.summary: Fechados, abertos e como escolher.

cards.title: Laboratórios de ponta
cards.text: Um punhado de empresas treina os modelos mais capazes, incluindo OpenAI (GPT), Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini) e Meta (Llama), com forte concorrência de laboratórios como Mistral, DeepSeek, Alibaba (Qwen) e xAI.

deep.x: The frontier is defined by the most capable general models. A small number of well-funded labs compete closely, with leadership shifting between them on different capabilities.
Competition dynamics
Leads tend to be short: capabilities first seen in one lab's model often appear in competitors' within months, and open-weight models typically trail the frontier by around a year or less.
Investment
Frontier labs raise and spend tens of billions on compute, data and talent; big tech companies invest hundreds of billions in AI data centres.
Regional players

x: China: DeepSeek, Alibaba, Moonshot, Zhipu and others
Many countries building sovereign models for language and data control

deep.x: For buyers, competition is good news: prices fall and quality rises quickly.

cards.title: Pesos fechados vs. abertos

items: você cuida da hospedagem e segurança

cards.text: Os modelos fechados são usados via API; o provedor os hospeda e atualiza. Os modelos de pesos abertos podem ser baixados, rodados de forma privada e ajustados, mas quem os opera é você.

deep.x: "Open-weight" models release their parameters for download; "closed" models are accessible only via the provider's API or apps.
Spectrum of openness

items.b: weights, code, often data and training details

deep.x: Enterprise considerations
Hybrid strategies
Many organisations combine both: closed models for complex tasks, open models on-premise for sensitive or high-volume tasks, behind a common gateway.
The Open Source Initiative published a formal definition of "open source AI" in 2024, stricter than most "open-weight" releases.

cards.title: Tamanhos e níveis de modelos
cards.text: Os provedores costumam oferecer níveis: modelos grandes para raciocínio difícil, médios para a maioria das tarefas, pequenos e rápidos para trabalhos simples em grande volume. Escolher o menor modelo que dá conta do recado economiza muito.

deep.x: Providers offer model families in several sizes. Larger models are more capable but slower and pricier; smaller ones are fast and cheap.
Price differences
Right-sizing
Speed matters too
For interactive use, latency affects user experience; small models can respond almost instantly.
Many production systems use several tiers at once, routed by task difficulty.

cards.title: Escolhendo um modelo
cards.text: Teste os candidatos nas suas próprias tarefas. Considere qualidade, velocidade, custo, tamanho do contexto, residência dos dados, termos de privacidade e como o fornecedor se encaixa na sua nuvem.

deep.x: Model selection should be driven by evaluation on your own tasks, not headlines or general benchmarks.
Evaluation process
Avoid lock-in
Re-evaluate regularly
With new releases every few months, revisit choices at least twice a year.
Teams often find that the "best" model differs by task: one excels at extraction, another at writing, another at code.

cards.title: Acesso corporativo
cards.text: Grandes empresas costumam usar os modelos pela sua nuvem: Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock ou Google Vertex AI, que oferecem segurança corporativa, hospedagem regional e contratos.

deep.x: Large organisations usually access models through cloud platforms that add enterprise security, compliance and integration.

items.b: OpenAI and other models in Microsoft's cloud

deep.x: What enterprises get
Integration benefits
Using your existing cloud simplifies security reviews, billing, networking and connecting AI to data already hosted there.
Capacity
High-volume users may need reserved or provisioned throughput to guarantee capacity and latency during peaks.
For companies standardised on one cloud, its AI platform is usually the path of least resistance, though multi-cloud access widens model choice.

cards.title: Roteamento de modelos
cards.text: Em vez de um único modelo para tudo, um roteador envia cada pedido ao modelo mais adequado: pequeno para consultas simples, grande para as complexas. Um gateway de IA pode cuidar do roteamento, dos registros e das cotas.

deep.x: Routing sends each request to the most appropriate model based on difficulty, cost, latency or data sensitivity.
Routing signals
AI gateways
An AI gateway sits between applications and models, providing routing, authentication, rate limits, cost tracking, logging, caching and fallback when a provider fails.

items: AI gateway: routing, keys, logs, quotas

deep.x: Savings
Routing most traffic to cheaper models while reserving premium models for hard cases can cut costs substantially without lowering quality, if the router is evaluated well.
Gateways also let organisations switch providers quickly during outages or when a better model appears.

cards.title: Uma área que anda rápido

items: Isole o modelo atrás de uma interface

cards.text: Novos modelos surgem a cada poucos meses, muitas vezes igualando o melhor do ano anterior por uma fração do preço. Projete os sistemas para poder trocar de modelo sem reescrever tudo.

deep.x: Model capabilities and prices change rapidly. Capability that cost a fortune one year can be cheap the next.
Architectural implications

items: Avoid deep coupling to one provider's features

deep.x: Deprecations
Providers retire older models on schedules; applications pinned to specific versions must migrate.
Strategy
Build durable assets, such as clean data, evaluation sets, integrations and user workflows, rather than betting on a particular model.
Assume the model you use today will be replaced within a year.

cards.title: As licenças importam
cards.text: Os modelos de pesos abertos vêm com licenças diferentes: algumas totalmente abertas (Apache 2,0, MIT), outras com restrições de uso ou limites para empresas muito grandes. Confira antes do uso comercial.

deep.x: Open-weight models come with licences that determine commercial use, modification and redistribution rights.

items.b: custom terms, restrictions for very large companies

deep.x: What to check
Outputs and derivatives
Some licences extend terms to fine-tuned derivatives; using outputs to improve competing models may be restricted.
Governance
Maintain a register of models in use, their licences and approved purposes, as with open-source software.
Some open-weight licences prohibit use by companies above a certain number of monthly users without a separate agreement.

cards.title: Benchmarks e rankings
cards.text: Rankings públicos comparam modelos em testes e votos de preferência humana. São sinais úteis, mas podem ser manipulados ou não refletir o seu caso de uso.

deep.x: Leaderboards aggregate benchmark scores or human preference votes to rank models. They're useful for orientation, but have limits.
Caveats

items: Contamination: test data seen in training
Style bias: preference for longer or friendlier answers

deep.x: Reading leaderboards
Treat leaderboards like restaurant rankings: a guide to what to try, not a substitute for tasting.

cards.title: Custo total de propriedade
cards.text: Os custos de API crescem com o uso; a hospedagem própria tem custos fixos de GPUs, engenharia e operação. Com volume baixo ou variável, as APIs costumam sair mais baratas; com volume muito alto e constante, a hospedagem própria pode compensar.

deep.x: Total cost of ownership (TCO) includes far more than per-token prices.

items: Model usage: tokens or GPU hours

deep.x: API vs self-hosting

items: can be cheaper at steady high volume

deep.x: Utilisation is key
Self-hosted GPUs are only cost-effective if well utilised. Idle GPUs at night or weekends raise effective cost per token.
Hidden costs

x: Prompt and pipeline maintenance as models change

deep.x: For many enterprise use cases, people costs for integration and change management exceed model usage costs.

quiz.q: Qual é uma vantagem dos modelos de pesos abertos?
options: Podem rodar de forma privada e ser personalizados
quiz.explain: Você controla a implantação.

quiz.q: O que faz um roteador de modelos?
options: Envia cada pedido ao modelo mais adequado
quiz.explain: Combina tarefas com modelos.

quiz.q: Como você deve escolher um modelo?
options: Testar os candidatos nas suas próprias tarefas e restrições
quiz.explain: Suas avaliações decidem.

lessons.title: Rodando modelos localmente
lessons.summary: IA no seu próprio notebook ou servidor.

cards.title: Por que rodar localmente?
cards.text: Privacidade (nada sai da sua máquina), uso offline, nenhum custo por token e controle total. A contrapartida: os modelos locais são menores e geralmente menos capazes que os modelos de ponta na nuvem.

deep.x: Running models on your own hardware gives control over data, cost and availability, at the cost of capability and maintenance.
Good reasons

items: Sensitive documents that can't leave your machine

deep.x: Typical hardware
The capability gap
Open models have narrowed the gap with frontier models, but the largest closed models still lead on complex reasoning and agentic tasks.
Local AI is ideal for privacy-first, focused tasks; frontier cloud models remain best for the hardest problems.

cards.title: Ferramentas

items.b: serviço em GPU de alto volume

cards.text: O Ollama e o LM Studio facilitam baixar modelos abertos e conversar com eles. O llama.cpp roda modelos de forma eficiente em CPUs e no Apple Silicon; o vLLM serve modelos em escala em GPUs.

deep.x: A rich ecosystem makes running local models straightforward.

items.b: command-line and API, simple model management
desktop app with chat and model browser
efficient C++ engine for CPUs and GPUs

deep.x: Typical workflow

steps: Chat or call the local API

deep.x: Interfaces

x: Open WebUI: a ChatGPT-like interface for local models
IDE plugins for local coding assistants
Home Assistant integrations for voice and automation

deep.x: Model sources
Hugging Face hosts most open models, with community-quantised versions in GGUF and other formats.
Ollama's model library lets you run a model with a single command like "ollama run llama3", downloading it automatically.

cards.title: A memória é o limite
cards.text: Os pesos do modelo precisam caber na RAM ou na memória da GPU. Com quantização de 4 bits, um modelo de 7–8B precisa de cerca de 4–5 GB; um de 70B, cerca de 40 GB.

deep.x: Model weights must fit in memory, plus space for the KV cache that grows with context length.
Rules of thumb
Unified memory advantage
Apple Silicon Macs share memory between CPU and GPU, so a 64 GB Mac can hold models a 24 GB GPU can't, though GPUs are usually faster per token.
Context costs memory
Long contexts need large KV caches; a model that fits with a 4k context might not fit with 64k.
Mixture-of-experts models need memory for all experts but compute for only a few, so they can run surprisingly fast if they fit.

cards.title: Formatos de quantização
cards.text: Os arquivos GGUF (para llama.cpp e Ollama) guardam pesos quantizados, como Q4_K_M ou Q8_0. Menos bits significam arquivos menores e mais rápidos, com alguma perda de qualidade.

deep.x: Quantisation formats define how weights are compressed. GGUF, used by llama.cpp and Ollama, is the most common for local use.
Choosing
Other formats

items: EXL2: flexible bit rates for GPUs

deep.x: Trade-off
Choose the largest model that fits at Q4–Q5 rather than a smaller model at Q8: bigger models usually lose less from quantisation.
The "K_M" variants use mixed precision, keeping sensitive layers at higher bits.

cards.title: Velocidade
cards.text: A velocidade é medida em tokens por segundo. Macs com Apple Silicon e muita memória unificada e PCs com GPUs grandes rodam modelos médios com folga.

deep.x: Local generation speed depends mainly on memory bandwidth: each token requires reading the active weights. Prompt processing depends more on compute.
What's usable?
Speed-ups
Batch vs interactive
For overnight batch jobs (classifying thousands of emails), slower speeds are fine; for chat and coding, speed matters more.
Reading speed is about 4–5 words per second, so ~10 tokens per second already feels like a fast typist.

cards.title: API local
cards.text: O Ollama e ferramentas parecidas expõem na sua máquina uma API compatível com a da OpenAI, então apps e scripts podem alternar facilmente entre modelos locais e na nuvem.

deep.x: Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp and vLLM can expose an HTTP API compatible with OpenAI's API format, so existing tools work with local models by changing the base URL.
Benefits

items: Switch between cloud and local by configuration

deep.x: Example

x: Same chat request format as cloud APIs

deep.x: Feature gaps
Not every feature matches cloud APIs exactly: tool calling, structured outputs and vision support vary by model and server. Test what you need.
An OpenAI-compatible local endpoint makes local models a drop-in option for many apps.

cards.title: RAG local
cards.text: Combine um modelo de embeddings local, um banco vetorial local e um LLM local para conversar com documentos privados totalmente offline.

deep.x: A fully local RAG stack keeps documents, embeddings and generation on your machine.
Components

items.b: small open models, e.g. nomic-embed or bge

deep.x: Use cases
Quality tips

x: Good parsing of PDFs and scans matters most
Choose an embedding model that handles your languages
Smaller local LLMs benefit from fewer, highly relevant passages

deep.x: Open WebUI includes built-in document upload and RAG, giving a private "chat with your files" in minutes.

cards.title: IA no homelab

items: Assistente de voz no Home Assistant

cards.text: Os homelabs rodam modelos locais junto com a automação residencial: resumir eventos das câmeras, assistentes de voz no Home Assistant ou classificar notificações, tudo sem a nuvem.

deep.x: Homelabs combine local AI with home automation, cameras and media, keeping data private and working without internet.

items.b: local LLM for summaries and commands

deep.x: Example automations

items: Summarise overnight camera events in a morning message
Voice control of lights and climate offline

deep.x: Architecture
Hardware

x: Mini PC with a Coral or small GPU for detection
Separate GPU box or Mac for LLMs

deep.x: Home Assistant's "Assist" can use a local LLM to understand flexible commands like "make it cosier in the living room".

cards.title: Bons usos locais
cards.text: Resumir, classificar, extrair, redigir e ajudar com código funcionam bem com modelos locais de porte médio. Raciocínio complexo ou documentos muito longos ainda podem exigir um modelo de ponta.

deep.x: Local models handle many everyday tasks well, especially focused ones with clear inputs.
Matching tasks to models
Hybrid approach
Use local models for private preprocessing (redacting personal data, classifying documents) and send only safe, minimal information to cloud models when needed.
Test local models on your actual tasks; many are better than expected.

cards.title: A segurança continua importando

items: Monitore o uso de disco e memória

cards.text: Local não significa automaticamente seguro: modelos e ferramentas baixados são software. Use fontes confiáveis, mantenha a API fora da internet pública e atualize com frequência.

deep.x: Local AI reduces data exposure to providers but introduces its own security responsibilities.

items: Prefer safe formats like GGUF or safetensors
Don't expose local APIs to the internet

deep.x: Model file risks
Older formats based on Python's pickle can execute code when loaded. Safer formats like safetensors and GGUF store only data.

items: safetensors or GGUF from trusted publishers

deep.x: Exposed servers
Security researchers have found thousands of local AI servers accidentally exposed to the internet without authentication, letting anyone use or probe them.
Agents at home
Local agents connected to home automation, files or email still face prompt injection and mistakes; apply the same guardrails as in business.
Default local AI server ports are often scanned by bots; bind services to localhost or protect them behind authentication.

quiz.q: Mais ou menos quanta memória um modelo de 8B precisa em 4 bits?
quiz.explain: Mais ou menos 0,5 byte por parâmetro, mais a sobrecarga.

quiz.q: Qual é a principal vantagem dos modelos locais?
options: Privacidade, uso offline e nenhum custo por token
quiz.explain: Os dados ficam na sua máquina.

quiz.q: Qual ferramenta facilita rodar modelos abertos localmente?
quiz.explain: CLI simples e API local.

lessons.title: Custo e velocidade
lessons.summary: Tokens, latência e como tornar a IA acessível em escala.

cards.title: Preço por tokens

viz.f: custo = tokens ent. × preço ent. + tokens saída × preço saída

cards.text: As APIs cobram por milhão de tokens de entrada e de saída. Os tokens de saída costumam custar várias vezes mais que os de entrada, e modelos maiores custam muito mais que os pequenos.

deep.x: Model APIs price usage per million tokens, with separate rates for input and output. Prices vary by model tier, provider, region and features like caching or batch processing.

v.f: cost = input tokens × input price + output tokens × output price

deep.x: Why output costs more
Input tokens are processed in parallel in one pass; output tokens are generated one at a time, each requiring a full pass through the model, so they use more compute per token.
Price tiers

v.unit: price per million output tokens, $ (illustrative tiers)

deep.x: Other charges
Many providers offer free tiers or credits for experimentation, but production use needs proper budgeting.

cards.title: Um exemplo prático
cards.text: 10,000 pedidos por dia, cada um com 2,000 tokens de entrada e 300 de saída. A $3 por milhão de tokens de entrada e $15 por milhão de saída: $60 + $45 = $105 por dia.

deep.x: Estimating costs early avoids surprises. Start from volumes and token counts per request.
Sensitivity
Hidden multipliers

x: Retries after errors or validation failures
Agent loops calling the model many times per task

deep.x: Budget controls
Always estimate at expected peak volume, not pilot volume.

cards.title: Latência
cards.text: Os usuários sentem dois atrasos: o tempo até o primeiro token (quanto demora para o texto começar) e a velocidade de geração (tokens por segundo). Fazer streaming da resposta faz a espera parecer menor.

deep.x: Two latency measures shape user experience: time to first token (TTFT), and output speed in tokens per second.
What drives latency
Example

x: Total ≈ 5.5 s, but text appears after 0.5 s

deep.x: Reducing latency
Reasoning models
Thinking time can add seconds to minutes before an answer starts. Show progress indicators or use them asynchronously.
Users perceive streamed answers as faster even when total time is the same, because they can start reading immediately.

cards.title: Use o menor modelo capaz
cards.text: Modelos pequenos podem ser de 10 a 50 vezes mais baratos que os maiores. Encaminhe as tarefas simples para eles e reserve os modelos grandes para os casos difíceis.

deep.x: The cheapest model that meets quality requirements should handle each task. Many tasks don't need frontier intelligence.
Task fit
Cascades
A cascade tries a cheap model first and escalates to a larger one only if confidence is low or validation fails.
Distillation
For very high-volume tasks, fine-tuning a small model on a large model's outputs can deliver large-model quality at small-model prices.
Measure quality per tier on your eval set; the cheapest acceptable tier usually wins.

cards.title: Encurte o prompt
cards.text: Enxugue as instruções, recupere menos trechos, porém melhores, e evite reenviar contexto que não mudou. Cada token economizado é economizado em todos os pedidos.

deep.x: Input tokens are multiplied by every request. Small savings per request add up at scale.
Example savings
Don't cut clarity
Removing context the model needs causes errors and retries that cost more. Test quality after trimming.
Structured outputs save tokens
Asking for JSON with defined fields avoids verbose prose when software is the consumer.
Tool and function definitions count as input tokens on every call; agents with dozens of tools carry a hidden token overhead.

cards.title: Cache
cards.text: Faça cache de prompts repetidos (cache de prompts) e de respostas repetidas (cache de respostas). Perguntas do tipo FAQ muitas vezes podem ser respondidas a partir de um cache.

deep.x: Two kinds of caching cut cost and latency: prompt caching at the provider and response caching in your application.

items: reuses whole answers to identical or similar questions

deep.x: Prompt caching
Put stable content (instructions, reference documents, tool definitions) at the start of prompts. Providers cache it for minutes to hours and charge a fraction for reuse.
Response caching
For FAQs or repeated queries, store answers and serve them directly. Semantic caching matches questions with similar meaning using embeddings.
Cautions

items: Expire cached answers when sources change
Don't cache personalised or sensitive answers inappropriately

deep.x: Caching is often the single biggest cost lever for high-traffic assistants.

cards.title: Processamento em lote
cards.text: Para trabalhos sem urgência, como classificar durante a noite um acúmulo de documentos, as APIs em lote oferecem grandes descontos (muitas vezes cerca de metade do preço) em troca de um prazo de retorno maior.

deep.x: Batch APIs process large sets of requests asynchronously, typically within 24 hours, at roughly half the normal price.
Good candidates
Workflow
Combining discounts
Batch processing can combine with prompt caching for further savings on repetitive workloads.
Overnight batch jobs let teams process years of archived documents for a modest one-off cost.

cards.title: O custo do raciocínio
cards.text: Os modelos de raciocínio geram muitos tokens de "pensamento" antes de responder. São mais precisos em tarefas difíceis, porém mais lentos e mais caros, então use-os onde a qualidade extra fizer diferença.

deep.x: Reasoning models generate hidden "thinking" tokens before the visible answer, billed as output tokens. A short visible answer might involve thousands of reasoning tokens.
When it's worth it
Effort controls
Many providers let you set reasoning effort or thinking budgets, balancing accuracy against cost and latency.
Measure
Compare cost per correct answer, not cost per request: if a reasoning model solves a task first time where a cheaper model needs three attempts and human fixes, it may be cheaper overall.
Use reasoning selectively, routed to the tasks that need it.

cards.title: Meça o custo por resultado
cards.text: Acompanhe o custo por chamado resolvido, por fatura processada ou por relatório, não só por token. Um modelo mais caro que precisa de menos novas tentativas e correções pode sair mais barato no total.

deep.x: Token prices are inputs; business value is measured per outcome: resolved tickets, processed invoices, completed reports.

v.f: cost per outcome = (model + infrastructure + human review) ÷ successful outcomes

deep.x: Example
Full picture
Comparing with the baseline
If an invoice used to take 6 minutes of staff time and now takes 1 minute of review plus €0.05 of AI, the saving is clear even with premium models.
Optimising for cheapest tokens can increase total cost if quality drops and humans must fix more.

cards.title: Os preços continuam caindo
cards.text: O preço de um dado nível de capacidade caiu drasticamente ano após ano. Planos que hoje parecem caros demais podem ser viáveis no ano que vem.

deep.x: The cost of a given capability level has fallen dramatically, driven by better hardware, efficient models, competition and inference optimisations.

v.unit: price for GPT-3.5-level capability, $ per million tokens (approx.)

deep.x: Implications

items: Revisit use cases rejected as too costly
Avoid long fixed-price commitments without review

deep.x: Jevons paradox
As AI gets cheaper per task, organisations use it for more tasks, so total spend often rises even as unit costs fall.
Frontier stays expensive
While old capability levels get cheap, the newest, most capable models remain premium-priced.
Plan for falling unit prices and rising usage at the same time.

quiz.q: Qual costuma custar mais por token?
quiz.explain: Gerar é mais caro.

quiz.q: Qual é uma opção mais barata para trabalhos em massa sem urgência?
quiz.explain: O processamento em lote troca velocidade por preço.

quiz.q: O que o streaming melhora?
options: A sensação de rapidez da resposta para o usuário
quiz.explain: O texto aparece à medida que é gerado.

lessons.title: IA multimodal
lessons.summary: Modelos que veem, ouvem e falam.

cards.title: Um modelo, muitas entradas
cards.text: Os modelos multimodais aceitam texto, imagens, áudio e às vezes vídeo na mesma conversa, e podem responder em texto, fala ou imagens.

deep.x: Natively multimodal models are trained on text, images, audio and video together, rather than bolting separate systems together. They can reason across modalities: relate a chart to a report, or a photo to a manual.
How images become tokens
Images are split into patches, encoded into embeddings, and placed in the same sequence as text tokens, so the model attends across both.
Milestones

events.l: real-time voice and native multimodal models

deep.x: Benefits

x: Fewer pipeline steps, fewer errors from conversions
Natural interfaces: show and tell instead of typing

deep.x: An image can consume as many tokens as a page of text, so multimodal requests cost accordingly.

cards.title: Lendo documentos visualmente
cards.text: Os modelos de visão leem documentos escaneados, formulários, tabelas e gráficos diretamente das imagens, muitas vezes dando conta de layouts que quebravam o OCR antigo.

deep.x: Vision-capable models read documents as images, interpreting layout, tables, stamps, handwriting and checkboxes, which traditional OCR pipelines often mangled.
Compared with classic OCR
Accuracy tips

items: Ask for structured output with field-level confidence

deep.x: Hybrid pipelines
Some systems combine fast OCR for raw text with a multimodal model for layout understanding and tricky fields.

steps: Multimodal model for layout and fields

deep.x: For commodity logistics, reading certificates of origin, quality certificates and bills of lading is a strong multimodal use case.

cards.title: Entendendo fotos
cards.text: Mostre a foto de uma peça quebrada, de uma doença de planta, de um quadro branco ou de um quadro de luz e faça perguntas. É útil para técnicos de campo e inspeções, com verificação humana.

deep.x: Multimodal models can interpret photos: identifying objects, reading labels, describing damage, and answering questions about what they see.
Workflow example

steps: Model reads nameplate and identifies issue

deep.x: Limits
Safety-critical use
For electrical, medical or structural assessments, treat model output as a hint for a qualified person, not a decision.

items: final safety decisions without expert check

deep.x: Photographing a fuse board and asking which circuit is which can save time, but always confirm with a tester before working on circuits.

cards.title: Gráficos e dashboards
cards.text: Os modelos conseguem descrever e analisar gráficos a partir de capturas de tela, embora possam ler errado os valores exatos. Para números precisos, use os dados de origem.

deep.x: Models can interpret charts from images, describing trends, comparing series and extracting approximate values. Exact numbers are less reliable.
Best practice

items: Provide the underlying data when precision matters
Ask for ranges rather than exact readings

deep.x: Generating charts
Rather than generating chart images, assistants with code tools create charts from data accurately, which you can then refine.
Dashboards
Screenshots of dashboards can be summarised for executives, but connecting the model directly to the data source is more reliable.
For decisions, use the data; for quick understanding, a chart screenshot works.

cards.title: Compreensão de vídeo
cards.text: Alguns modelos conseguem assistir a um vídeo e resumi-lo, encontrar momentos ou responder a perguntas sobre ele, o que é útil para conteúdo de treinamento, reuniões e inspeções.

deep.x: Video models sample frames and audio to answer questions, summarise content, find specific moments and describe actions.
Long videos
Long videos consume many tokens; models sample frames at intervals, so very brief events may be missed.
Combining with transcripts
Pairing visual analysis with speech transcripts gives the richest understanding: what was said and what was shown.
Privacy
Video often contains identifiable people; apply data protection rules and consent requirements.
Some models can process an hour of video in a single request thanks to million-token context windows.

cards.title: Voz em tempo real
cards.text: Os modos de voz permitem conversar naturalmente com o assistente, interromper e receber respostas faladas, o que é prático ao dirigir ou com as mãos ocupadas.

deep.x: Real-time voice modes let you converse naturally with an assistant, with low latency, interruptions and expressive speech.

items.b: for those who find typing hard

deep.x: Behind the scenes
Native speech-to-speech models process audio directly, preserving tone and enabling quick turn-taking, unlike older systems that transcribed, thought in text and then spoke.
Tips

items: Ask it to keep answers brief
Switch to text for complex outputs like tables

deep.x: Caution
Avoid sharing sensitive information aloud in public spaces, and remember voice recordings may be stored depending on settings.
Voice turns AI into a conversation partner you can use while your hands are busy.

cards.title: Geração de imagens no chat
cards.text: Os assistentes multimodais podem criar e editar imagens dentro da conversa: diagramas, mockups, ilustrações, ajustados com pedidos seguintes.

deep.x: Modern assistants can generate and edit images in the conversation, keeping context: you can refine a diagram or mock-up through follow-up messages.

steps: "Make the arrows blue and add labels"

deep.x: Uses
Improved text rendering
Native multimodal image generation follows instructions and renders text far better than earlier diffusion models, making it useful for posters and diagrams, though details still need checking.

items: struggled with text and complex instructions

deep.x: Brand and rights
Generated visuals for external use should follow brand guidelines and licence terms of the tool.
Being able to say "keep everything, just change the background" made iterative image work far more practical.

cards.title: Acessibilidade

items: Leitura de texto em voz alta

cards.text: A IA multimodal descreve imagens para pessoas cegas e com baixa visão, lê textos em voz alta e transcreve a fala para pessoas surdas, ampliando o acesso à informação.

deep.x: Multimodal AI expands access to information for people with disabilities.

items.b: describe photos, read signs and documents

deep.x: Real apps
Apps like Be My Eyes integrated multimodal AI in 2023, letting blind users get detailed descriptions of their surroundings, products and screens.
Inclusive design
Limits
AI descriptions can be wrong; for critical tasks like medication labels, users may still want human verification.
Accessibility features often help everyone: captions, summaries and voice control are widely used beyond their original audience.

cards.title: Limites
cards.text: Os modelos podem ler errado textos pequenos, contar objetos errado, confundir itens parecidos ou ser enganados por imagens incomuns. Confira tudo o que for crítico para a segurança.

deep.x: Multimodal models have characteristic failure modes worth knowing.

items: Confusing left and right or spatial relations

deep.x: Visual hallucination
Models may "see" things that aren't there, especially when prompts suggest them ("describe the dog in this photo" when there's no dog).

items.r: "Is there a defect? If so, describe it, if not, say none is visible"

deep.x: Adversarial images
Text hidden in images can act as prompt injection, instructing the model to do something unintended.
Testing
Evaluate on your real images, including poor lighting and unusual angles, before relying on visual analysis.
Asking neutral questions instead of leading ones noticeably reduces visual hallucinations.

cards.title: Privacidade nas imagens
cards.text: As fotos podem conter rostos, placas de carro, documentos ou localizações. Confira o que você está compartilhando, principalmente no trabalho.

deep.x: Images carry more personal data than people realise: faces, licence plates, documents in the background, screens, location metadata.
Workplace rules
Reduce exposure
Biometric data
Facial images processed to identify people are biometric data, a special category under GDPR with strict rules.
Before uploading a photo, scan it for anything you wouldn't want to share.

quiz.q: O que os modelos multimodais aceitam?
options: Texto, imagens, áudio e às vezes vídeo
quiz.explain: Vários tipos de entrada.

quiz.q: Para obter números exatos de um gráfico, o melhor é…
options: Confiar em uma captura de tela
quiz.explain: Capturas de tela dão aproximações.

quiz.q: Qual é uma limitação dos modelos de visão?
options: Contar errado ou ler errado pequenos detalhes
quiz.explain: Confira os detalhes críticos para a segurança.

lessons.title: Riscos e uso responsável
lessons.summary: Mau uso, vieses, propriedade intelectual e segurança das pessoas.

cards.title: Um mapa dos riscos
cards.text: Os riscos incluem respostas erradas, resultados enviesados, vazamento de dados confidenciais, questões de direitos autorais, deepfakes e fraudes, uso para fins nocivos e dependência excessiva dos usuários.

deep.x: Generative AI risks span technical, legal, ethical and organisational dimensions. Frameworks like the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (2023) and ISO/IEC 42001 (2023) help organise them.
Likelihood and impact
Risk management cycle
Proportionality
Controls should match risk: lightweight for internal brainstorming, rigorous for customer-facing or decision-making systems.
A use-case inventory with risk ratings is the foundation of AI governance.

cards.title: Vazamento de dados
cards.text: Colar dados confidenciais em ferramentas de IA para consumidores pode enviá-los para fora da sua organização. Use ferramentas corporativas aprovadas, que não treinam com os seus dados e atendem aos seus requisitos de segurança.

deep.x: Data leakage happens when confidential or personal information reaches places it shouldn't: external providers without agreements, other users, logs or model training.

items: data may be retained or used per consumer terms

deep.x: Incidents
In 2023 Samsung engineers reportedly pasted confidential source code into a public chatbot, leading the company to restrict such tools.
Leakage paths
Controls
Banning AI tools outright often drives usage underground; providing safe approved tools is more effective.

cards.title: Vieses

items: Revisão humana em decisões sobre pessoas

cards.text: Os modelos refletem padrões dos seus dados de treinamento e podem produzir resultados estereotipados ou desiguais. Teste os resultados entre diferentes grupos em usos que afetam pessoas, como contratação ou crédito.

deep.x: Generative models can reproduce stereotypes: assuming professions' genders, under-representing groups in images, or treating dialects and names differently.

items: Different tone by names or dialects

deep.x: Testing

steps: Create matched prompts varying only group attributes

deep.x: High-stakes uses
Using generative AI to screen CVs, assess employees or evaluate creditworthiness falls into high-risk categories under the EU AI Act, requiring rigorous bias testing and oversight.
Mitigations
Test with the people your system will serve, in the languages they use.

cards.title: Propriedade intelectual

items: Use ferramentas com garantia de PI

cards.text: Continuam as dúvidas sobre o treinamento com obras protegidas e a propriedade dos resultados de IA. Confira se o texto ou o código gerado não reproduz material protegido e siga a política da sua empresa.

deep.x: IP risks run both ways: outputs may infringe others' rights, and your inputs may expose your own IP.

items.b: generated text or code resembling protected works

deep.x: Code assistants
Some coding tools offer filters that block suggestions matching public code, and vendors may offer indemnities against copyright claims.

items: Keep human authorship in key work
Document AI use for important assets

deep.x: Copyright of outputs
In many places, purely AI-generated outputs may not be protected by copyright; meaningful human creative contribution matters.

items: publishing AI output that mirrors a known work

deep.x: Several major AI providers offer enterprise customers legal indemnity for copyright claims arising from model outputs, under conditions.

cards.title: Dependência excessiva
cards.text: As pessoas tendem a confiar demais em uma IA fluente e confiante, uma forma de viés de automação. Mantenha as pessoas envolvidas e responsáveis, principalmente em decisões importantes.

deep.x: Automation bias leads people to accept AI outputs without enough scrutiny, especially when they're fluent, fast and usually right.
Evidence

A 2023 Harvard–BCG study found consultants using AI performed much better on tasks within AI's capabilities, but were more likely to get wrong answers on a task just outside them, trusting flawed outputs.
Deskilling
Relying on AI for tasks you never learn can leave you unable to spot errors. Deliberate practice and understanding remain important.
Countermeasures

items: Require brief human reasoning for key decisions
Train staff on AI failure modes

deep.x: The "jagged frontier": AI is excellent at some tasks and poor at similar-looking ones; know where the edges are.

cards.title: Proteções contra mau uso
cards.text: Os provedores treinam os modelos para recusar pedidos claramente nocivos e monitoram abusos, principalmente em torno de armas, ciberataques e segurança infantil. As tentativas de jailbreak são um jogo de gato e rato sem fim.

deep.x: Model providers apply layered safeguards against misuse: training models to refuse harmful requests, classifiers detecting dangerous content, usage policies and abuse monitoring.
Priority risks
Jailbreaks
Users try role-play, encoding and multi-step tricks to bypass refusals. Providers patch vulnerabilities and run bug bounties; it's an ongoing contest.
Balance
Good safeguards minimise both harm and unnecessary refusals, allowing legitimate medical, security and research questions while blocking real uplift for attackers.
Providers report regularly on misuse they've detected and disrupted, such as influence operations and scam networks.

cards.title: Transparência

items: Explique decisões com apoio de IA

cards.text: Avise as pessoas quando estiverem interagindo com uma IA ou lendo conteúdo gerado por IA, quando isso for relevante. O AI Act da UE exige isso para chatbots e deepfakes.

deep.x: Transparency about AI use supports trust, informed choice and accountability.

items.b: document AI involvement in key work

deep.x: Legal requirements
The EU AI Act requires informing people they're interacting with an AI system (unless obvious), and labelling deepfakes and certain AI-generated public-interest text.
Practical approaches
When disclosure matters most
Honest disclosure rarely hurts trust; discovering undisclosed AI use often does.

cards.title: Pegada ambiental

items: Prefira data centers com energia renovável

cards.text: Treinar e rodar modelos grandes consome muita eletricidade e água para refrigeração. Modelos eficientes, dimensionamento adequado e energia limpa reduzem essa pegada.

deep.x: Generative AI uses energy for training and, increasingly, for inference at massive scale, plus water for cooling data centres and resources for chips.
Context
Estimates per request have fallen as hardware and models improve; recent provider disclosures put a typical text query at fractions of a watt-hour. Total demand still grows with usage.
Reducing footprint

items: Don't generate what you won't use

deep.x: Corporate reporting
Companies increasingly include AI-related emissions in sustainability reporting under rules like the EU's CSRD.
Training one frontier model can use as much electricity as thousands of homes for a year, but daily global use now likely exceeds training energy.

cards.title: Políticas no trabalho
cards.text: Boas políticas de IA são curtas e práticas: quais ferramentas são aprovadas, que dados podem ser usados, quando a revisão humana é obrigatória e como relatar problemas.

deep.x: An effective AI policy enables safe use rather than just prohibiting. Keep it short, clear and updated.

items: Approved tools and how to access them
Data rules: what may and may not be entered

deep.x: Data traffic light

items.b: highly confidential or personal data, specific approved systems only

deep.x: Training
Pair policy with practical training: examples of good use, common mistakes and how to verify outputs. The EU AI Act requires adequate AI literacy for staff using AI.
Governance roles
Assign owners: an AI governance group, data protection officer, security and business sponsors for each major use case.
A one-page policy people actually read beats a fifty-page document nobody follows.

cards.title: Use a IA para ajudar, não para enganar
cards.text: Use a IA generativa para trabalhar melhor, não para forjar provas, se passar por outras pessoas ou enganar. A honestidade sobre o uso de IA gera confiança com colegas e clientes.

deep.x: The ethical line is less about whether AI was used and more about honesty: not misleading others about facts, authorship or identity.
Examples of misuse

items: Submitting AI work as solely your own where prohibited

deep.x: Professional integrity
Many professions now issue guidance: lawyers must verify citations, journalists disclose AI use, academics follow journal rules on AI authorship.
Building trust

items.b: when it matters to the reader

deep.x: Fake AI-generated reviews are now explicitly targeted by consumer protection rules in the EU and US.

quiz.q: Qual é o principal risco de colar dados confidenciais em um chatbot para consumidores?
options: Os dados podem sair da organização ou ser usados para treinamento
quiz.explain: Use ferramentas corporativas aprovadas.

quiz.q: O que é o viés de automação?
quiz.explain: As pessoas confiam demais em uma IA fluente.

quiz.q: O que o AI Act da UE exige dos chatbots?
options: Que avisem os usuários de que estão interagindo com uma IA
quiz.explain: Obrigações de transparência.

lessons.title: Usando bem a IA generativa
lessons.summary: Hábitos práticos para o trabalho do dia a dia.

cards.title: Comece pelos seus gargalos
cards.text: Liste as tarefas que tomam seu tempo e envolvem muito texto: e-mails, relatórios, resumos, atas de reunião, pesquisa, planilhas. É ali que a IA costuma ajudar primeiro.

deep.x: The best first uses of AI are tasks you do often, that take real time and involve text or information processing.
Prioritise
Track your time
For a week, note tasks that feel repetitive or slow. Then test AI on the top three and measure time saved.
Start small
Pick one workflow, refine it until it works reliably, then expand.
Focus on workflows, not features: where does your time actually go?

cards.title: Rascunhe, não delegue às cegas

items: Rascunho da IA: estrutura e 1ª versão

cards.text: Use a IA para os primeiros 70–80% e dedique seu esforço à parte que exige o seu julgamento: decisões, nuances, relacionamentos.

deep.x: AI accelerates the first draft; your expertise turns it into something good. The goal is better work in less time, not outsourcing judgement.
A good division of labour
Quality tip
Give the AI your key points and reasoning first; it then structures and expresses them, instead of inventing positions.
AI-assisted work should still sound like you and reflect your thinking.

cards.title: Resuma para decidir

items.r: "resuma para decidir: opções, custos, riscos"

cards.text: Peça resumos que apoiem uma decisão: "Quais são as três opções, os custos e riscos de cada uma, e o que está faltando?"

deep.x: Generic summaries compress; decision-focused summaries help you act. Tell the AI what decision you face.

items.r: "Summarise for a go/no-go decision: options, costs, risks, open questions"

deep.x: Useful summary formats

items: Options with pros, cons and costs

deep.x: Executive summaries
For leaders, ask for a one-paragraph bottom line up front, then supporting bullets, then details if needed.
Verify the basis
Ask the summary to reference which sections support each point, so you can check before deciding.
Asking "what would make this recommendation wrong?" surfaces assumptions summaries often hide.

cards.title: Aprenda mais rápido
cards.text: A IA é uma professora paciente: peça que ela explique um conceito em diferentes níveis, faça perguntas para testar você ou dê exemplos da sua área.

deep.x: AI tutors adapt explanations to your level, answer follow-ups instantly and generate practice questions.
Techniques

items: "Explain like I'm new to this, then like an expert"

deep.x: Research supports active learning
Studies of AI tutoring found students learned more when the AI guided them through problems rather than giving answers directly.
Verify as you learn
Cross-check key facts with reliable sources, especially in unfamiliar fields where you can't spot errors.
Use AI to make you think more, not less: ask it to question you.

cards.title: Analise dados

steps: A IA escreve e roda o código

cards.text: Com um interpretador de código, a IA consegue limpar planilhas, fazer cálculos e desenhar gráficos. Confira o código e os números antes de compartilhar os resultados.

deep.x: With code execution, assistants clean data, compute statistics, build charts and explain findings, letting non-programmers do real analysis.
Good prompts for analysis

items: Describe the columns and their meaning
Ask for assumptions to be listed

deep.x: Common pitfalls
Verify
Reconcile totals with known figures, spot-check a few rows, and review the code if the result matters.
Asking the AI to "first describe the dataset and any data quality issues" often reveals problems before analysis begins.

cards.title: Escreva melhor, com a sua voz
cards.text: Dê à IA amostras dos seus textos e peça que ela imite o estilo. Peça que enxugue, esclareça ou deixe o texto mais direto.

deep.x: AI can match your style if you show it examples, and improve clarity without making text generic.

items: Ask for specific edits: shorter, clearer, more direct
Review for anything that doesn't sound like you

deep.x: Editing modes

items.b: same message for a different audience

deep.x: Avoid the generic AI voice
Overused phrases and excessive enthusiasm make text sound machine-written. Ask for plain, specific language and remove filler.

items.w: "In today's fast-paced world, it's crucial to leverage synergies"
items.r: "We can save two weeks by sharing the test team"

deep.x: Multilingual
AI helps write in other languages, but have important texts reviewed by a fluent speaker, especially for European Portuguese nuances.
Use AI as an editor that sharpens your voice, not one that replaces it.

cards.title: Prepare-se para reuniões
cards.text: Antes de uma reunião, peça um briefing a partir dos documentos relevantes, as perguntas prováveis e uma proposta de pauta. Depois, transforme as anotações em itens de ação.

deep.x: AI can turn scattered documents into a focused briefing and turn meetings into clear outcomes.
Before the meeting
After the meeting
Negotiations
Role-playing a negotiation with AI, asking it to play the counterpart, helps you anticipate arguments and refine your position.
Sending a crisp summary with decisions and owners within an hour of a meeting dramatically improves follow-through.

cards.title: Conhecimento pessoal
cards.text: Guarde bons prompts em uma biblioteca, salve resultados úteis e crie pequenos assistentes reutilizáveis (GPTs personalizados, projetos do Claude, agentes do Copilot) para tarefas repetidas.

deep.x: Building a personal AI toolkit, with saved prompts, reusable assistants and organised references, compounds productivity over time.
Custom assistants
Organising knowledge
Keep key reference documents (style guides, product facts, glossaries) ready to attach, so assistants work from accurate context.
Share with your team
Sharing effective prompts and assistants spreads good practice and saves everyone time.
Every time you write a great prompt, save it; that's how expertise accumulates.

cards.title: Saiba quando não usar
cards.text: Não use IA quando a precisão for crítica e você não puder conferir, quando a confidencialidade proibir ou quando o contato humano for o que importa, como em conversas delicadas.

deep.x: AI is a powerful tool, but some situations call for restraint.
Human connection
Condolence messages, difficult feedback and personal apologies carry weight because they come from you. AI can help you think, but the words should be yours.
Verification cost test
If checking the AI's output would take as long as doing the task yourself, and errors matter, AI may not save time.

items.b: do it yourself or with experts

deep.x: Confidentiality
When in doubt about data sensitivity, don't paste it; ask your data protection or security team.
People report AI is most useful for tasks they already know well enough to judge the result.

cards.title: Continue melhorando
cards.text: As ferramentas melhoram a cada poucos meses. Volte a tarefas que não funcionavam antes, compartilhe dicas com os colegas e mantenha alguns experimentos em andamento.

deep.x: AI tools change fast. Habits of regular experimentation keep your skills current.
Habits

items: Monthly: retry a task that failed before
Keep a log of useful prompts
Follow a couple of trusted sources

deep.x: Measuring your progress
Team learning
Communities of practice, short demos and shared libraries spread skills across organisations faster than formal training alone.
Stay critical
Enthusiasm and scepticism both have a place: test claims on your own work, and keep human judgement at the centre.
The best way to understand AI is to use it thoughtfully, every week.

quiz.q: Qual é uma boa forma de dividir o trabalho com a IA?
options: A IA rascunha a maior parte, e você aplica seu julgamento ao que importa
quiz.explain: Seu esforço vai para onde o julgamento é necessário.

quiz.q: Um pedido melhor do que "resuma este relatório" é…
options: "Resuma para uma decisão de seguir ou não: opções, custos, riscos, questões em aberto"
quiz.explain: Vincule o resumo à decisão.

quiz.q: Quando você deve evitar depender da IA?
options: Quando a precisão é crítica e você não consegue verificar
quiz.explain: A verificação é essencial.
